title: Trim lead-in (ms)
description: Time kept before the first object of each trimmed section. Used until a profile sets its own value.

title: Trim lead-out (ms)
description: Time kept after the last object of each trimmed section.

title: Gap between sections (ms)
description: Silent break placed between trimmed sections.

title: Section audio fade (ms)
description: Fade-in and fade-out at the edges of each trimmed section. 0 cuts hard.

title: Change pitch with rate
description: Default for new profiles: rate changes also shift pitch (like Nightcore/Daycore) instead of keeping it.

title: Lazer export folder
description: Existing absolute folder for lazer .osz exports. Empty keeps them in the tool's data folder. Stable maps are always written next to the original difficulty.

title: Use Mania ratings for the trim timeline
description: For mania maps, draw the trim strip from the Mania ratings tool's local MSD when it is installed; otherwise notes per second.
